slides.title: The big idea
slides.html:
Napoleon's Theorem: build an equilateral triangle outward on each side of any triangle. The centers of those three equilateral triangles are the vertices of another equilateral triangle.

Surprising facts like this are proved with tools beyond this course (rotations by 60 degrees, complex numbers or trigonometry), but you can test it by dragging. The name is traditional; there is no good evidence that Napoleon Bonaparte discovered or proved it. Enrichment.
